title: Witchinour
description:
Witchinour is a roguelite twin stick shooter focused on fast, 60fps action and constantly increasing difficulty. You play as an explorer who comes across a dungeon that an apprentice witch named Nour found herself lost in years ago on a full moon...Witchinour has:• 7 increasingly dangerous areas to fight (and loop) your way through

• 6 class abilities, 5 spells, 21 weapons, and 40 upgrades to help you descend the dungeon

• 1 dynamic difficulty system that wants you dead

• 6 levels of stacking difficulty modifiers to unlock to push your skills to the limit
